messages:
Alex (PM): Short decision thread: customer pilot requires promptstore + per-tenant rate-limits. Eng says both are ~1.5 weeks. We have two options: (1) slip v1 by 2 weeks to include them, or (2) keep current milestone and ship an MVP with a scoped feature set + clear comms. Need a call before EOD.

Riya (Eng): Promptstore is backend heavy (indexing + permissions). We could ship a read-only export/import shortcut for pilots in ~3 days as a temporary mitigation. Rate-limits are simpler: we can do coarse tenant caps in 48h but not fine-grained per-route.

Omar (SRE): If we do coarse caps, we should also add an alert for token-usage spikes and a temporary quota override knob for Sales. That avoids surprise overages.

Tom (Sales): Pilot (GreenfieldCo) will sign if they have prompt persistence and per-tenant throttle. They tolerable a manual onboarding step, but rate-limits are a blocker.

Nina (Design): For promptstore mitigation we can ship a small "Download prompts" + "Upload prompts" flow that looks native. Low effort UI, copy finalized in a day.

Alex (PM): Tradeoff proposal: keep date, cut advanced per-route analytics and deferred in-app connectors to v1. Deliver the prompt export/import + coarse tenant caps + quota override. Sales gets pilot commitment and we promise an engineering sprint for full promptstore + fine-grained limits post-launch.

Riya (Eng): I can do the coarse caps + override in 48h and the export/import in 3 days. Need SRE help for alerts and a feature-flag rollout.

Omar (SRE): I'll add the token-usage alert and prepare a feature-flagged rollout. Also will stand up a temporary "pilot-ops" team page for manual overrides.

Tom (Sales): This is acceptable as long as we get a signed pilot agreement and a roadmap date for full promptstore. I'll push for that.

exec-bot: Noted: leadership informed. Summary memo queued for 17:30.

Alex (PM): Consensus = keep date + scoped mitigations. Action items: @Riya implement coarse caps + export/import; @Omar alerts + override page; @Nina prompt UX + copy; @Tom secure pilot signature; I'll update roadmap and draft the pilot comms. Reconvene tomorrow 09:00 to verify readiness.

Riya (Eng): Starting on caps now, will post a design snippet in #eng-platform.

Omar (SRE): Will create alert playbook. If we see >2x expected tokens/hr we abort and propose a 2-week slip.

Tom (Sales): On it. Thanks team :rocket:
